arxiv-1811-05875.title: WAVE: Machine Learning for Full-Waveform Time-Of-Flight Detectors
arxiv-1811-05875.creator: Glenn R. Jocher, Kurtis Nishimura, John Koblanski, Viacheslav A. Li
arxiv-1811-05875.description: Abstract We propose a WA veform V ector E xploitation ( WAVE ) deep neural network for full-waveform Time-Of-Flight (TOF) physics detectors, and evaluate its performance against traditional reconstruction techniques via Monte Carlo study of a small plastic-scintillator scatter camera. Ultralytics LLC ( https://www.ultralytics.com ) provides WAVE freely under the open source GPL-3.0 license at https://github.com/ultralytics/wave .

arxiv-1903-02979.title: Computability on quasi-Polish spaces Thanks: This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No 731143
arxiv-1903-02979.creator: Mathieu Hoyrup, Cristóbal Rojas, Victor Selivanov, Donald M. Stull
arxiv-1903-02979.description: Abstract We investigate the effectivizations of several equivalent definitions of quasi-Polish spaces and study which characterizations hold effectively. Being a computable effectively open image of the Baire space is a robust notion that admits several characterizations. We show that some natural effectivizations of quasi-metric spaces are strictly stronger.

arxiv-2209-10240.title: Fingerprinting Robot Movements via Acoustic Side Channel CCS: Security and privacy Systems security CCS: Security and privacy Side-channel analysis and countermeasures
arxiv-2209-10240.creator: Ryan Shah, Mujeeb Ahmed, Shishir Nagaraja
arxiv-2209-10240.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ryan Shah, Mujeeb Ahmed, Shishir Nagaraja. In this paper, we present an acoustic side channel attack which makes use of smartphone microphones recording a robot in operation to exploit acoustic properties of the sound to fingerprint a robot’s movements. In this work we consider the possibility of an insider adversary who is within physical proximity of a robotic system (such as a technician or robot operator), equipped with only their smartphone microphone.

arxiv-2302-00801.title: A tutorial on networks in social systems: A mathematical modeling perspective Thanks: The author gratefully acknowledges her co-organizers Michelle Feng, Alexandria Volkening, and Mason Porter, along with the American Mathematical Society, for their support and dedication in organizing this short co
arxiv-2302-00801.creator: Heather Z. Brooks
arxiv-2302-00801.description: Abstract . This article serves as an introduction to the study of networks of social systems. First, we introduce the reader to key mathematical tools to study social networks, including mathematical representations of networks and essential terminology. We describe several network properties of interest and techniques for measuring these properties.

arxiv-2405-00540.title: Heat, Health, and Habitats: Analyzing the Intersecting Risks of Climate and Demographic Shifts in Austrian Districts
arxiv-2405-00540.creator: Hannah Schuster, Axel Polleres, Amin Anjomshoaa, Johannes Wachs
arxiv-2405-00540.description: Abstract The impact of hot weather on health outcomes of a population is mediated by a variety of factors, including its age profile and local green infrastructure. The combination of warming due to climate change and demographic aging suggests that heat-related health outcomes will deteriorate in the coming decades.

arxiv-2410-19232.title: α \alpha Effect and Magnetic Diffusivity β \beta in Helical Plasma under Turbulence Growth
arxiv-2410-19232.creator: Kiwan Park
arxiv-2410-19232.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kiwan Park. We investigate the transport coefficients α \alpha and β \beta in plasma systems with varying Reynolds numbers while maintaining a unit magnetic Prandtl number. The α \alpha and β \beta tensors parameterize the turbulent electromotive force (EMF) in terms of the large-scale magnetic field 𝐁 ¯ {\bf\overline{B}} and current density ¯ {\bf\overline{}} as follows : ⟨ 𝐮 × 𝐛 ⟩ = α 𝐁 ¯ − β ∇ × 𝐁 ¯ \langle{\bf u}\times{\bf b}\rangle=\alpha{\bf\overline{B}}-\beta{\nabla\times\bf\overline{B}} .

arxiv-2504-10516.title: No-Go Theorems for Universal Quantum State Purification via Classically Simulable Operations
arxiv-2504-10516.creator: Keming He, Chengkai Zhu, Hongshun Yao, Jinguo Liu, Yinan Li, Xin Wang
arxiv-2504-10516.description: Abstract Quantum state purification, a process that aims to recover a state closer to a system’s principal eigenstate from multiple copies of an unknown noisy quantum state, is crucial for restoring noisy states to a more useful form in quantum information processing.

arxiv-2602-21399.title: FedVG: Gradient-Guided Aggregation for Enhanced Federated Learning
arxiv-2602-21399.creator: Alina Devkota, Jacob Thrasher, Donald Adjeroh, Binod Bhattarai, Prashnna K. Gyawali, [0.4em] West Virginia University, University of Aberdeen, Fogsphere (Redev.AI)[0.4em] {ad00139,jdt0025}@mix.wvu.edu, {donald.adjeroh,prashnna.gyawali}@mail.wvu.edu,binod.bhattarai@abdn.ac.uk
arxiv-2602-21399.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across multiple clients without sharing their private data. However, data heterogeneity across clients leads to client drift, which degrades the overall generalization performance of the model. This effect is further compounded by overemphasis on poorly performing clients.

britannica-1911-arcot.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-arcot.description: Article 'Arcot' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. a military cantonment. The most famous episode in its history is the capture and defence of Arcot by Clive. In the middle of the 18th century, during the war between the rival claimants to the throne of the Carnatic, Mahommed Ali and Chanda Sahib, the English supported the claims of the former and the French those of the latter.

pmc-10574956.title: User Re-Identification via Confusion of the Contrastive Distillation Network and Attention Mechanism
pmc-10574956.creator: Mingming Zhang, Bin Wang, Sulei Zhu, Xiaoping Zhou, Tao Yang, Xi Zhai, Marina Gavrilova
pmc-10574956.description: With the rise of social networks, more and more users share their location on social networks. This gives us a new perspective on the study of user movement patterns. In this paper, we solve the trajectory re-identification task by identifying human movement patterns and then linking unknown trajectories to the user who generated them.

pmc-11689783.title: THE STARTING A TESTOSTERONE AND EXERCISE PROGRAM AFTER HIP INJURY (STEP-HI) TRIAL: STUDY RESULTS AND IMPLICATIONS
pmc-11689783.creator: Ellen Binder, Douglas Kiel
pmc-11689783.description: Hip fractures are common among older women and can have a devastating impact on their ability to remain independent. Many women who were high functioning before the hip fracture do not return to their pre-fracture level of function, have persistent weakness and mobility impairments, and may require ongoing supportive services.

pmc-11721126.title: Cracking the code: ET-1 signaling unlocks new therapies for virus-induced osteoarthritis
pmc-11721126.creator: Wern Hann Ng, Patrick Chun Hean Tang, Suresh Mahalingam
pmc-11721126.description: Rheumatic symptoms such as joint inflammation and pain are known features of SARS-CoV-2 infection, though the mechanisms remain unclear. Au and colleagues identified the interaction between the viral spike protein and the endothelin-1 (ET-1) signaling pathway as a cause of osteochondral damage.

pmc-12467896.title: Environmental Hazards and Chemoresistance in OTSCC: Molecular Docking and Prediction of Paclitaxel and Imatinib as BCL2 and EGFR Inhibitors
pmc-12467896.creator: Nishant Kumar Singh, Prankur Awasthi, Agrika Gupta, Nidhi Anand, Balendu Shekher Giri, Saba Hasan
pmc-12467896.description: Simple SummaryOral tongue squamous cell carcinoma (OTSCC) is a type of mouth cancer that can be caused by both inherited and environmental factors, such as exposure to harmful substances. Some drugs, such as the chemotherapy medication Irinotecan, can reduce the effectiveness of common treatments.

pmc-12571988.title: Psychometric Properties of the Persian Self‐Advocacy in Cancer Survivorship Scale (SACS‐P) in Iran
pmc-12571988.creator: Elaheh Habibpour, Nargess Ramazanzadeh, Sevda Gardashkhani, Mehraban Shahmari
pmc-12571988.description: BackgroundSelf‐advocacy is crucial for cancer patients, as it allows them to express their needs and engage in treatment decisions. This skill enhances the quality of care and life satisfaction. Accurately measuring self‐advocacy and supporting patients with lower skills is essential to improving treatment outcomes and promoting patient‐centered care.

pmc-12598941.title: Mileage matters: long-distance performance of CARs in multiple myeloma
pmc-12598941.creator: Eric M Jurgens, Saad Z Usmani, Maximilian Merz
pmc-12598941.description: Targeting B-cell maturation antigen with chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cells is a new standard of care in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM). However, long-term data have currently remained sparse. In a recent study published in the Journal for ImmunoTherapy of Cancer by Jin et al, authors reported on a large cohort of 141 patients with a median follow-up of 20.2 months.

pmc-13375235.title: Women's Satisfaction With Quality of Abortion Care, Associated Factors, and Barriers in Public Health Facilities of South Gondar Zone, Ethiopia: A Mixed Study
pmc-13375235.creator: Tesfalem Ketema, Zemenu Shiferaw Yadita, Dabere Nigatu
pmc-13375235.description: Background and AimsClient satisfaction is a key indicator of abortion care quality, influencing both service use and outcomes. While Ethiopia has expanded access to comprehensive abortion care, limited evidence exists on client satisfaction in conflict‐affected areas like South Gondar Zone.

pmc-13437355.title: The role of macrophages in radiation-induced lung injury: from pathological mechanisms to therapeutic targets
pmc-13437355.creator: Xiaochi Ma, Jie Lu, Tao Zhong, Xin Wang, Xiao Liu, Wen Huo, Xiaozheng Chen

pmc-13468346.title: Grinding Metamorphic Layer of Bearing Steel: Formation Mechanisms, Characterization, and Process Parameter Effects
pmc-13468346.creator: Jiayu Guo, Tao Xia, Dingbo Cao, Xue Liu, Wei Zhang, Yong Liu, Jingchuan Zhu
pmc-13468346.description: Grinding is the final precision machining step for bearing rings, which induces subsurface gradients in microstructure and mechanical properties. Rolling contact fatigue life and service reliability are directly determined by the gradients. Current research of the grinding metamorphic layer in bearing steels is synthesized in this review.

uslaw-usc-t21-s158.title: 21 U.S.C. § 158 — Offenses; punishment
uslaw-usc-t21-s158.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t21-s158.description: United States Code, Title 21 (Food And Drugs); Chapter 5 (Viruses, Serums, Toxins, Antitoxins, And Analogous Products). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any person, firm, or corporation who shall violate any of the provisions of this chapter shall be deemed guilty of a misdemeanor, and shall, upon conviction, be punished by a fine of not exceeding $1,000 or by imprisonment not exceeding.
